CustomField.description: Categorizes the sale as either "Inventory Sales" or "New Sales" based on the Unit Launch Date. New Sales: Launch Date and Sold Date Same Year Inventory Sales:Launch Date and Sold Date is different
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( AND( ISBLANK(Unit__r.Unit_Sold_Date__c), YEAR(Unit__r.Project_Launch_Date__c) = YEAR(TODAY()) ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Unit__r.Unit_Sold_Date__c)), YEAR(Unit__r.Project_Launch_Date__c) = YEAR(Unit__r.Unit_Sold_Date__c) ) ), "New Sale", "Inventory Sale" )
CustomField.label: Unit Sale Category
